title: Skills migration follow-ups: project cutover, new-skill classification, pruning passes
description:
Follow-ups from the 2026-07-06 skills migration (project -> dotfiles/agents), agreed with Anders:

1. project cutover: strip the duplicated/stale Orchestration & Model Economics + Parallel Work block from project/AGENTS.md (points at the global file now); dedup shared skills best-variant-wins (autoreview, obsidian-markdown, pro-brief, zoom-out, grill-me/grilling, lint — diff both variants, take the better material); classify project-only generals (fan-out, handoff, session-viewer, tufte-viz, recap) for possible promotion to dotfiles/agents/skills; delete project copies after verification.
2. visual-plan deep prune: 470 lines, sprawl per writing-great-skills — progressive-disclosure pass.
3. officecli watch: ~/.claude/skills is now a symlink into dotfiles; if a plugin/updater recreates or updates officecli there it lands in the repo — classify (track vs gitignore) when it happens.
4. project resident skills pass: 9 repo skills still model-invoked (~570 always-loaded tokens in project sessions); invocation-mode + description-trim pass with skillctl conventions.
5. simplify: stayed in project per Anders' ruling; revisit global promotion + rename (collides with built-in /simplify).

comments.author: anders
comments.text: project cutover DONE (2026-07-06): two codex calibration lanes diffed all 6 duplicate pairs + audited the 5 candidates.
